$comment: spec 022 — schema for runs/votes/FREEZE.json and runs/curator/FREEZE.json. Replaces the earlier loose {file: hash} object map, which could silently omit files and carried no commit identity (Codex Stage-5 BLOCKER #6). `files` is the EXACT, complete list for its directory: PR-025 requires set equality with the directory's actual contents, so an omission is now a gate failure rather than an invisible gap. A commit cannot name its own SHA, so custody is anchored by `evidence_commit` (the commit whose tree the frozen evidence was read at, which must be an ancestor of the freeze commit git derives) rather than by a self-referential field.
